name: API Xref Hunter
description: Find every function that calls any API from a configurable set of names, and what the binary does with what those APIs return.
longdescription:
Define a set of API names (glob, regex, substring or exact match) and get every function in the binary that calls any of them, grouped by caller. Ships with editable presets for registry, network, process injection, crypto, filesystem, dynamic resolution and anti-analysis APIs. Supports transitive caller discovery, a clickable markdown report, and optional tagging so hits appear in the Tags sidebar.

Branch analysis answers the other half of the question: which conditionals test what an API returned, and what code each arm of those conditionals guards. It follows the return value and any out-parameter through MLIL SSA def-use to the `if` that reads them, then reports the calls that only happen because the branch went one way — so you can see the block a registry read actually gates, and which API results the binary ignores entirely.
